- Capture a short evidence checklist (SOC2 items, data retention settings, KMS options) so your security/procurement teams can pre-scan before the demo.

Available windows next week (all PT):
- Wed 11 Aug: 10:00–10:30 or 14:00–14:30
- Thu 12 Aug: 09:00–09:30 or 13:00–13:30

Can you confirm which slot works and who from your security/procurement team should join (or if we should run the demo without them and record for review)? I attached a one-pager mapping of the demo scope to the triage use case to make scheduling easier.

Attachments: redwood-demo-map-compact.pdf

Thanks — I’ll loop in Rishi from security and Karthik on solution architecture once we have a confirmed slot.
